slides.title: This can read your *ENTIRE* table
slides.code:
SELECT vbeln, posnr FROM vbap
  FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_orders
  WHERE vbeln = @lt_orders-vbeln
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_items).
slides.voiceover: This one line can read your entire table.
slides.spoken: This one line can read your entire table.

slides.heading: If it is *empty*...
slides.code:
SELECT vbeln, posnr FROM vbap
  FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_orders
  WHERE vbeln = @lt_orders-vbeln
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_items).
slides.voiceover: If the driver table is empty, the WHERE condition is ignored, and the whole VBAP table is read.
slides.spoken: If the driver table is empty, the WHERE condition is ignored, and the whole VBAP table is read.

slides.heading: The fix: *one IF*
slides.code:
IF lt_orders IS NOT INITIAL.
  SELECT ... FOR ALL ENTRIES ...
ENDIF.
slides.voiceover: The fix is simple. Check IS NOT INITIAL first.
slides.spoken: The fix is simple. Check IS NOT INITIAL first.

slides.title: Save this *for interviews*
slides.voiceover: Interviewers ask this too. Save it.
slides.spoken: Interviewers ask this too. Save it.

posts.caption:
One missing IF, and the report read the entire VBAP table.

With FOR ALL ENTRIES, an empty driver table means the WHERE condition is ignored and every row is selected. Always check IS NOT INITIAL first, and remove duplicates from the driver table.

This is a classic interview question, so save it.
